# t.me

> > Telegram's official web interface for viewing public channels, groups, and bots without requiring the app.

t.me serves as Telegram's public-facing web portal, hosting official channels like Telegram News, platform-specific update channels (Desktop, Android, iOS), release tracking, support resources, and millions of public channels covering topics from tutorials to news. It allows anyone to preview Telegram content through a web browser.

## Key Topics

- Telegram
- Telegram Desktop
- Telegram for Android
- Telegram X
- Telegram Premium
- iOS
- macOS
- Linux
- Cross-platform messaging
- Official channels
- Version updates
- FAQ and support
- Telegram bots
- Public channels
- AyuGram

## Official Telegram Channels

- [Telegram News](https://t.me/telegram): Official Telegram News channel landing page with 11M+ subscribers
- [Telegram News Feed](https://t.me/s/Telegram): Official Telegram News channel with feature updates and announcements
- [Telegram Desktop](https://t.me/desktop): Official Telegram Desktop channel with developer updates
- [Telegram Usernames](https://t.me/username): Official Telegram Usernames channel for auction updates (1.3M subs)

## Platform Updates & Releases

- [Telegram Stable Releases](https://t.me/s/tgstable): Stable release tracking for all official Telegram clients across platforms
- [Telegram Updates & Features](https://t.me/s/HelpCenter_Telegram): Telegram Updates & Features channel with beta announcements for Android
- [Telegram X for Android](https://t.me/s/tgx_android): Telegram X for Android update announcements and version history
- [Telegram Beta Features](https://t.me/s/HelpCenter_Telegram/34): Telegram beta features post: My Profile tab and channel recommendations
- [Telegram WebK Updates](https://t.me/s/FAQTelegram/2556): Telegram WebK 1.5 update with multiple tabs support announcement

## Support & FAQ

- [Telegram Support & FAQ](https://t.me/helpfaq_telegram): Telegram volunteer support & FAQ group in multiple languages
- [AyuGram FAQ](https://t.me/AyuGramFAQ): AyuGram FAQ channel with 8.9K subscribers
- [AyuGram Troubleshooting](https://t.me/s/AyuGramFAQ/18): AyuGram antivirus false positives and authentication troubleshooting
- [Mr Smart Helper FAQ](https://t.me/s/mrsmarthelper): Myanmar Telegram FAQ with auto-download and settings tutorials
- [NotLetters Support](https://t.me/s/notletters_support): NotLetters temporary email service support with blocked domains FAQ
- [GT-APP FAQ Bot](https://t.me/GT_App_FAQ_bot): GT-APP FAQ support bot with answers to common questions
